'''Kruy Mulacks''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Carthasian]] and host of the [[Kruy Mulacks Show]]. His [[Holoshow/Legends|holoshow]] recording crew was present at the opening of the [[Temple of Tet-Ami]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Carthas]], on [[Benja-Rihn]].
